displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 31 is 3 short and 1 long
meaning: High-heat pressure switch or relay did not close, or it reopened. The chart says the control relay may be defective or the gas valve may be mis-wired, and it says to see status code 32.
causes: High-heat pressure switch or relay did not close or reopened
diySteps: Count 3 short flashes and 1 long flash. Do not jumper the high-heat pressure switch
Technician: follow status code 32 for the vent, inducer, and tubing checks this chart points at, and check the relay and gas-valve wiring named on 31
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. High-heat pressure faults are not a filter replacement.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
